cards.text: Samuel, the boy Hannah dedicated to the LORD, is now ministering to the LORD before Eli the priest at Shiloh (1 Samuel 1:28; 2:11). Eli's two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are priests there too (1 Samuel 1:3). And friend, the first thing you need to know about those two: they were wicked men, and they had no regard for the LORD.

cards.question: Eli's sons have regard for the custom of the priests with the people.

cards.text: Here's how it goes at Shiloh. When any man offers a sacrifice, the priest's servant comes over while the meat is still boiling, and he's carrying something.

cards.question: What does the priest's servant bring over to the boiling sacrifice?

cards.text: He plunges that fork into the pan or kettle or cauldron or cooking pot. If it's boiling, friend, that fork is going IN.

cards.question: Whatever the meat fork brings up out of the pot, the priest claims it for ___.
The fork in the pot only happens to a few of the Israelites who come to Shiloh.

cards.text: It gets worse. Even before the fat is burned, the servant walks up to the man sacrificing with a demand, like somebody reaching into my oven before the timer even goes off.

cards.question: Before the fat is burned, the servant says the priest wants meat to roast, and the priest will only accept it ___.

cards.text: And if a man pushes back and says burn the fat first, then take whatever you want, that sounds fair, right? You'd THINK so.

cards.question: If a man says to burn the fat first, how does the servant answer him?

answers.text: Give it now or I take it by force
Fine but the priest wants extra
Then the priest will take none

cards.question: In the sight of the LORD, the sin at these sacrifices is severe.
The sin is severe because the LORD's offering is being treated with ___.

cards.text: Now step away from all that grabbing and take a breath, friend. The boy Samuel is ministering before the LORD, wearing a linen ephod.
Each year his mother Hannah comes up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice. And she brings Samuel something she made for him.

cards.question: What does Hannah make for Samuel and bring to him each year?

cards.text: And each year Eli blesses Elkanah and Hannah. He says may the LORD give them children by Hannah in place of the one she dedicated to the LORD.

cards.question: The LORD attends to Hannah after Eli's blessing. How many more children does she have?

cards.text: Meanwhile, friend, the boy Samuel grows up in the presence of the LORD.
Now Eli is very old, and he hears about everything his sons are doing to all Israel. He even hears that they're sleeping with the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
Eli confronts his sons: "Why are you doing these things?" He says he hears about their wicked deeds from all these people.

cards.question: Eli tells his sons that the report going around about them among the LORD's people is a good one.
Eli tells his sons that if a man sins against another man, God can step in for him. What does Eli suggest about a man who sins against the LORD?

answers.text: No one can step in for him
Only Eli can step in for him
His family can step in for him

cards.question: Eli's sons take their father's warning to heart and listen to him.

cards.text: They wouldn't listen, since the LORD intended to put them to death. That one's heavy, friend.

cards.question: Meanwhile, the boy Samuel keeps growing in stature. How else is he growing?

answers.text: In favor with the LORD and with man
In honor among the city elders
In charge of the priests' servants

cards.text: Then a man of God comes to Eli with a word from the LORD, and friend, this is NOT a social call. The LORD reminds Eli that He clearly revealed Himself to Eli's father's house back when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh's house.

cards.question: Out of all the tribes of Israel, the LORD selected Eli's father to be His ___.

cards.text: The LORD also gave Eli's father's house ALL the food offerings of the Israelites. So He asks Eli why he kicks at the sacrifice and offering He prescribed for His dwelling place.

cards.question: The LORD tells Eli that he has honored his ___ more than Him.

cards.text: And the LORD says how that honoring shows: "by fattening yourselves with the best of all the offerings of My people Israel."
The LORD had said Eli's house would walk before Him FOREVER, friend. And now He declares, "Far be it from Me!"

cards.question: The LORD says He will honor those who honor Him, but He will overlook those who despise Him.

cards.text: Then the LORD says the days are coming when no one in Eli's house will reach old age. All his descendants will die by the sword of men.

cards.question: The LORD gives Eli a sign about his two sons, Hophni and Phinehas. What is it?

answers.text: They will both die on the same day
They will be taken captive together
They will die many years apart

cards.text: But then, friend, the message turns. The LORD says He will raise up a faithful priest for Himself and build him an enduring house, and that priest will walk before the LORD's anointed one for all time.

cards.question: The LORD says this faithful priest will do whatever is in the LORD's heart and mind.
Everyone left in Eli's house will come and bow down to that faithful priest and plead to be appointed to some ___ office.

cards.text: The LORD says they'll be bowing for a piece of silver or a morsel of bread, just so they can eat. We'll leave it right there for now, friend, but this story is not done.
